blocks.text: Field ke perpendicular chalti rod mein motional emf ε = −vBL hai. Motional emf aur baqi induced emfs ko magnetic flux ke zariye bhi bayan kiya ja sakta hai. Fig. 10.14 ka experiment dobara dekhein. Rod chhote se waqt Δt mein position 1 se position 2 tak jati hai. Is waqt mein rod ka tay kiya hua distance (faasla) x₂ − x₁ = Δx hai.

blocks.alt: Wahi patriyan aur galvanometer; rod Position 1 par dashed aur Position 2 par solid. Neeche x1 galvanometer wale sire se Position 1 tak, Δx Position 1 se Position 2 tak, aur x2 galvanometer wale sire se Position 2 tak. Dono positions ke darmiyan ki patti ΔA hai; L patriyon ka faasla; current I oopar wali patri par baen; B kaghaz ke andar.
blocks.caption: Figure 10.14: Rod Position 1 se Position 2 tak Δx chalti hai aur loop ka area (jagah ka phailao) ΔA barhta hai (kitab ki Figure 10.14 ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Waqt Δt mein rod Δx = x₂ − x₁ chalti hai, is liye loop ka area ΔA = LΔx barhta hai aur flux Δϕ = BΔA barhta hai. Isi se ε = −Δϕ/Δt nikalta hai.
Rod constant velocity v se chal rahi hai, is liye:
v ki yeh value Eq. 10.19 mein rakhein:
Rod Δx chale to loop ka area ΔA = ΔxL barhta hai, aur loop se flux Δϕ = (ΔA)B barhta hai. Eq. 10.22 mein (ΔxL)B = Δϕ rakhein:

blocks.title: Point to Ponder
blocks.text: Copper ka ek chhalla (ring) aise rectangular (lamba chaukor) hisse se guzarta hai jahan constant magnetic field kaghaz ke andar ki taraf hai. Positions 2, 3 aur 4 par chhalle mein current ke bare mein aap ka kya andaza hai?

blocks.alt: Tanbe ka chhalla positions 1 se 5 tak seedha neeche girta hai. Positions 2 aur 4 rectangular field wale hisse (cross: field kaghaz ke andar) ke oopar aur neeche kinare par hain, aur position 3 us ke andar hai. Position 2 par chhalle ke oopar curved (mura hua) teer anticlockwise, aur position 4 par chhalle ke neeche curved teer clockwise hai.
blocks.caption: Point to Ponder (PDF page 240): Tanbe ka chhalla aise rectangular hisse se guzarta hai jahan constant magnetic field kaghaz ke andar hai; positions 2, 3 aur 4 par chhalle mein current (kitab ke is box ki tasveer ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Position 2 par chhalla field mein dakhil ho raha hai: andar ki taraf flux barh raha hai, is liye current anticlockwise behta hai taa ke us ki field (kaghaz se bahar) is increase (barhna) ko oppose kare. Position 3 par chhalla poora andar hai, flux nahi badalta, current zero. Position 4 par chhalla nikal raha hai, flux ghat raha hai, is liye current clockwise hai.
Eq. 10.23 batati hai ke agar conducting coil ke ek loop se magnetic flux badal raha ho, to loop mein induced emf flux ki change (badlao) ki rate (fi second change) ke negative ke barabar hai.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab yahan 'Equation (10.20)' likhti hai, magar Eq. 10.20 to ε = −vBL sinθ hai. Flux ki change wali equation ε = −Δϕ/Δt Eq. 10.23 hai, is liye sahi hawala Eq. 10.23 hai.
Agar ek loop ki jagah N loops wali coil ho to induced emf N guna ho jati hai:
Yeh formula motional emf se nikala gaya hai, magar har haal mein sahi hai. Yeh result sab se pehle Faraday ne nikala, is liye ise Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka law kehte hain:

blocks.title: Faraday ka electromagnetic induction ka law
blocks.text: N loops wali conducting coil mein induced average (darmiyani value) emf us rate ke negative ke barabar hai jis se coil se guzarne wala magnetic flux waqt ke saath badal raha ho.
Negative (minus) sign batati hai ke induced emf ki direction aisi hoti hai ke woh flux ki change ko oppose (rokne ki koshish) kare.

blocks.title: For Your Information
blocks.text: Yeh wahi heater hai jo upar 'Point to ponder!' mein hai (kitab ne yeh baat do dafa chhapi hai): coil ka ac badalta flux banata hai, bartanon mein emf banti hai, metal ke bartan mein current pani garam karta hai, sheeshe ke bartan mein current nahi behta.

blocks.prompt: Copper ka chhalla aise rectangular hisse se guzarta hai jahan constant magnetic field kaghaz ke andar hai; positions 2 (dakhil hote), 3 (poora andar) aur 4 (nikalte) par chhalle mein current ka kya hota hai (Point to Ponder)? Ek square (murabba) loop uniform field mein chalta hai aur us ka normal field ke parallel hai; kya emf induce hoti hai (short question 10.2)?
blocks.explanation: 2 par chhalle se flux barh raha hai, is liye current induce hota hai; 3 par chhalla poori tarah uniform field mein hai, flux constant hai, current zero; 4 par flux ghat raha hai, is liye current ulti direction mein behta hai. Square loop ke liye uniform field mein chalte hue flux BA constant rehta hai, is liye koi emf induce nahi hoti.

blocks.prompt: 15 cm side aur 60 turns wali square coil 0.8 T field mein hai aur us ki surface field ke perpendicular hai; use 2 s mein 30° ghumaya jata hai. Average induced emf nikalein (numerical 10.3).
blocks.explanation: Shuru mein fi turn flux BA = 0.8 × 0.0225 = 1.80 × 10⁻² Wb; ghumane ke baad BA cos30° = 1.56 × 10⁻² Wb; change 2.41 × 10⁻³ Wb. Average emf = NΔϕ/Δt = 60 × 2.41 × 10⁻³/2 = 7.2 × 10⁻² V. Kitab ka jawab 0.54 V tabhi aata hai jab poora flux, 60 × 1.80 × 10⁻² Wb, 2 s mein khatam ho jaye; yeh jaanch ke liye darj hai.

items: Motional emf: lambai L ki rod v se B ke aar paar; qvB charges ko rod ke saath dhakelti hai jab tak qE = qvB (10.17); emf ki amount vBL (kitab −LvB, 10.19), angle par vBL sinθ (10.20); induced current abcda par anticlockwise.
Faraday ka law: ε = −Δϕ/Δt (10.23); N turns ke liye ε = −NΔϕ/Δt (10.24); negative sign ka matlab emf flux ki change ko oppose karti hai. Istemal: wireless chargers, induction heaters.
